name: How to Prepare Your Luxury Condo for a Seamless Sale

step.name: Step 1: Conduct a Thorough Unit Valuation and Building Review – Before listing, understand your condo's worth. This goes beyond comparable sales; it includes assessing your specific unit's features, views, and condition against the backdrop of your building's overall health and recent sales. Also, get a clear picture of the building's financial standing, including budgets, reserves, and any pending capital projects or assessments. An A.I. Certified Agent™ can provide predictive market analytics to guide this crucial step.

step.name: Step 2: Collect All Necessary Association and Disclosure Documents – This is critical for condo sales. Start gathering your seller disclosures, the resale or association package, budgets, bylaws, rules, meeting minutes, insurance information, and any notices of litigation. Be aware that document production times can vary, so getting this started early prevents delays later on. This also helps you anticipate buyer questions about rental restrictions, pet policies, or renovation rules.

step.name: Step 3: Prepare Your Unit for Optimal Presentation – In the luxury market, your condo needs to look its absolute best. This means decluttering, depersonalizing, and potentially undertaking minor repairs or staging. Ensure all areas are pristine, paying attention to high-end finishes and appliances. If you've done renovations, verify all permits are in order and easily accessible.

step.name: Step 4: Arrange for Professional Media Capture and Floor Plans – Generic photos just won't cut it. Invest in professional photography, high-definition video tours, and accurate floor plans. For luxury condos, a 3D virtual tour can be a game-changer, allowing potential buyers to virtually walk through the space at their convenience and truly appreciate its layout and features.

step.name: Step 5: Understand Building Access and Showing Procedures – Coordinate with your association and listing professional to establish a clear plan for showings. This includes knowing any building-specific access rules, security protocols, and potential move-in/move-out restrictions. A well-organized showing strategy ensures your unit is accessible to qualified buyers while respecting building regulations.
step.text: What to Expect During the Process Once your condo is prepared, your listing professional will publish the listing, manage qualified-buyer showings, and evaluate offers. This phase involves skilled negotiation, coordinating with the association, and ensuring all title, lender, and inspection requirements are met. It's a comprehensive process where an experienced advocate makes a significant difference.
